questions.question: The number of daily visitors to the City Museum, y, can be estimated using the equation y = 0.75x + 41.3, where x represents the number of years since 2008 and x <= 12. Which of the following statements is the best interpretation of the number 0.75 in the context of this problem?

choices.A: The estimated number of daily visitors to the City Museum in 2008
choices.B: The estimated yearly increase in the number of daily visitors to the City Museum
choices.C: The estimated number of daily visitors to the City Museum in 2020
choices.D: The estimated yearly decrease in the number of daily visitors to the City Museum

questions.explanation: 0.75 is the slope, and it is positive: the estimate increases by about 0.75 each year.
